verdict.rationale: Docs describe an autonomous 'cloud agent' that can plan, execute, and open PRs for review/merge (docs-3, docs-6, docs-8, docs-15), and agent mode can edit files (docs-2), implying it stages changes and creates branches/PRs. However, no explicit mention of automated commit-message generation or branch creation, and no community evidence confirms this end-to-end workflow in practice.
